verdict.rationale: The docs say an LLM judge can be attached as a scorer on tasks to assess qualities such as clarity or completeness. Scorers return a 0–1 value with configurable pass thresholds, and the scorer set is versioned and pinned to each evaluation run. That covers the core of the story, but the depth of configuration is thin. missing for 10: documentation of judge configuration (custom rubrics/prompts, judge model selection), worked examples of LLM-judge scorers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
